name: lookma
description: Talk to your Mac. Watch it work. A voice-driven agent that operates your real screen in plain sight.
author: Jiawei Liu

scripts.check: for f in core/*.mjs core/executor/*.mjs core/voice/*.mjs core/dev/*.mjs executors/*/*.mjs executors/*/dev/*.mjs voices/*/*.mjs voices/*/*.js voices/*/dev/*.mjs overlay/*.js overlay/voice/*.js overlay/hand/*.js overlay/dev/*.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node core/dev/check-plugins.mjs && node core/dev/check-pipeline.mjs && node core/dev/check-outbox.mjs && node core/dev/check-executors.mjs && for f in executors/*/dev/check.mjs voices/*/dev/check.mjs; do node $f || exit 1; done && node overlay/dev/consent-check.mjs && node overlay/dev/floor-check.mjs && node overlay/dev/source-check.mjs && node overlay/dev/hand-check.mjs
scripts.test:overlay: node overlay/dev/check-voices.mjs && node overlay/dev/check-hands.mjs && node overlay/dev/shoot.mjs
scripts.test:key: mkdir -p app/build && swiftc -swift-version 5 -parse-as-library -o app/build/talkkey-check app/Sources/TalkKey.swift app/dev/talkkey-check.swift && app/build/talkkey-check
scripts.test:gesture: mkdir -p app/build && swiftc -swift-version 5 -parse-as-library -o app/build/gesture-check app/Sources/HandFrame.swift app/Sources/Gesture.swift app/dev/gesture-check.swift && app/build/gesture-check
